title: Implement and operate the TDE Operator Readiness View proving slice
summary: Create and operate one bounded operator-facing UI slice that makes the TDE self-UI proving experiment inspectable through real execution state rather than descriptive documents alone.

body.request_text: Implement and operate the TDE Operator Readiness View proving slice as the first live task set for the TDE self-UI proving experiment, under the declared limitation that the broader producer/adapter-to-runtime-to-operated-proof chain is only partially proven and any manual rescue must be logged.

requested_action: Implement and operate the TDE Operator Readiness View proving slice as the first bounded self-UI experiment slice.
success_signal: A bounded operator-facing UI slice exists, reflects real task/runtime state or post-build event updates, and leaves behind an inspectable evidence package.
